meta.title: GST Recon (2-Way, Third-Party Integration): refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Finance Controller on the specified Enterprise tenant and verify whether GST Recon is refused or absent.
Repeat GST Recon using a Finance Controller and verify that the action is available and can reconcile invoice GST against GSTR-2B through the third-party GST tool.
Verify or record the tenant's Enterprise plan and any RBAC configuration affecting GST Recon.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Finance Controller on the specified Enterprise tenant and verify whether GST Recon is refused or absent.; Repeat GST Recon using a Finance Controller and verify that the action is available and can reconcile invoice GST against GSTR-2B through the third-party GST tool.; Verify or record the tenant's Enterprise plan and any RBAC configuration affecting GST Recon.

args.need: sign in as the non-Finance Controller and Finance Controller users on the specified Enterprise tenant, check whether GST Recon (2-Way, Third-Party Integration) is absent or refused for the first user, then verify it is available and can reconcile invoice GST against GSTR-2B for the Finance Controller

steps.note: No catalog step can access GST Recon, switch between the required role-specific users, or exercise the third-party GST reconciliation flow.
Provides a known-screen assertion after the tester handoff, but does not validate GST Recon behavior.
